verdict.rationale: Belvo is an open-finance API platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question. Its homepage advertises "Belvo MCPs" for connecting AI agents to open finance, and its developer docs offer install flows for an MCP server in Cursor and VS Code. That is first-party evidence that an agent can connect via an official MCP server, though the evidence is thin and does not say whether the server exposes the financial APIs or only the docs. Missing for 10: documentation of the MCP tools or capabilities exposed, auth/setup details beyond the install links, clarity on whether it is a docs-only or API MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
